text: Since the Azores is an autonomous region of Portugal, you will often come across various types of Portuguese infrastructure, such as poles, chevrons and bollards.
text_zh: 由於亞速群島是葡萄牙的自治區，你經常會遇到各種葡萄牙基礎設施，例如電線桿、轉彎標誌和路樁。

text: Most of the Azores visible on Street View consists of open agricultural fields in a rolling landscape, often with taller round hills in the background.
NOTE: Madeira has a very mountainous landscape, and very rarely has open agricultural fields.
text_zh: 在街景上看到的亞速群島大部分是起伏地形中的開放農田，背景往往有較高的圓形丘陵。
註：馬德拉的地形非常多山，極少有開放農田。

text: **Dry rock walls** made of volcanic rocks are very common on the Azores.
NOTE: Dry rock walls are not common on Madeira, and while they are somewhat common on mainland Portugal, they will not be made of volcanic rocks.
text_zh: 由火山岩堆砌的**乾石牆**在亞速群島非常常見。
註：乾石牆在馬德拉不常見；雖然在葡萄牙本土還算常見，但並非由火山岩製成。

text: **Hydrangeas** can commonly be seen on the Azores.
NOTE: They can rarely be found on Madeira.
text_zh: **繡球花**在亞速群島非常常見。
註：它們在馬德拉很少見。

text: Japanese cedars ([cryptomeria japonica](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cryptomeria)) are very common on the Azores.
NOTE: While they can less commonly be seen on Madeira, they are not native to any part of mainland Europe.
text_zh: 日本杉 ([日本柳杉](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cryptomeria)) 在亞速群島非常常見。
註：雖然它們在馬德拉較少見，但它們並不原產於歐洲大陸的任何地方。

text: Houses in the Azores are typically one or two stories, with an orange tiled roof. They are painted **white** or in **pastel colours**, and dark green shutters on windows are common.

While you can also find [yellow](https://maps.app.goo.gl/eKrCqxAGLvi8JfKr8) or [blue](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tztY4hFYy1q7exjYA) highlights like in mainland Portugal, **grey highlights** are almost exclusive to the Azores.
text_zh: 亞速群島的房子通常是一到兩層樓，帶有橘色瓦片屋頂。牆面塗成**白色**或**粉彩淺色**，窗戶上常見深綠色的百葉窗。
雖然你也可以像在葡萄牙本土一樣找到[黃色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/eKrCqxAGLvi8JfKr8)或[藍色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tztY4hFYy1q7exjYA)的裝飾外框，但**灰色邊框**幾乎是亞速群島獨有的。

text: Street signs in the Azores are almost exclusively painted ceramic tiles, with blue letters and, typically, a decorative pattern around the edge.
text_zh: 亞速群島的路牌幾乎清一色是彩繪磁磚，帶有藍字，邊緣通常有裝飾花紋。

text: Signposts on the Azores are often striped.
NOTE: These are also seen on Madeira.
text_zh: 亞速群島上的標誌桿通常帶有條紋。
註：這些在馬德拉也能看到。

text: **Black and white cows** are very common on the Azores.
NOTE: Cows on Madeira are usually [brown with white spots](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6cXY7T6okctmsJ9FA).
text_zh: **黑白相間的乳牛**在亞速群島非常常見。
註：馬德拉的牛通常是[棕底白斑](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6cXY7T6okctmsJ9FA)。

text: The only islands in the Azores with car coverage are Ilha de São Miguel, Ilha Terceira and Ilha do Faial.
text_zh: 亞速群島中唯一有汽車街景覆蓋的島嶼是聖米格爾島、特塞拉島和法亞爾島。

text: The only island with **Generation 4** coverage is Ilha de São Miguel.
text_zh: 唯一擁有 **第 4 代** 覆蓋的島嶼是聖米格爾島。

text: **Shitcam** coverage is found on Ilha de São Miguel and Ilha do Faial.

The car seen on [São Miguel](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JAvRHWSUTF1WN64C8) has an **indentation** in the centre, while the one on [Faial](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SFnsE3SAKAeeX8Pw7) appears as a smooth surface, sometimes with an antenna visible.
text_zh: **爛畫質相機**覆蓋範圍可在聖米格爾島和法亞爾島找到。
在[聖米格爾島](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JAvRHWSUTF1WN64C8)看到的車車頂中央有一個**凹槽**，而[法亞爾島](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SFnsE3SAKAeeX8Pw7)上的車頂則呈現平滑表面，有時可看到天線。

text: Ilha de São Miguel is the only island in the Azores or Madeira where you can find lakes.
text_zh: 聖米格爾島是亞速群島或馬德拉群島中唯一可以看到湖泊的島嶼。

text: Rock walls with a white painted concrete top are somewhat common on Ilha Terceira.
text_zh: 頂部塗有白色混凝土的石牆在特塞拉島算蠻常見的。

text: On Ilha do Faial, you will sometimes find traditional whitewashed rock walls with unevenly sized dark basalt stones.
text_zh: 在法亞爾島上，你有時會看到傳統石灰刷白、夾雜大小不一深色玄武岩的石牆。

text: A trekker going along the edge of a crater can be seen on Ilha do Faial.
text_zh: 在法亞爾島上可以看到沿著火山口邊緣拍攝的徒步拍攝。
